purpose: The acceptance target for the M07 remediation, written from source inspection BEFORE any implementation change. The remediation is not accepted because more chains appear; it is accepted when this specific chain is recovered correctly and precision does not fall.

primary_criterion.statement: At least one complete chain that begins in genuine frontend TypeScript — not a test, not a Python client, not a server-side TypeScript route — and ends at a database table, every node being the correct declaration and every edge carrying evidence, confidence and provenance.

chain.source_fact: usePoolServicePostPool({...}) — hand-written frontend code under ui/src, not generated, not a test

chain.kind: generated client function — the HTTP observation site

chain.source_fact: @pools_router.post("") where pools_router = AirflowRouter(tags=["Pool"], prefix="/pools") at pools.py:51, included by public_router = AirflowRouter(prefix="/api/v2") at routes/public/__init__.py:56 — composed served path POST /api/v2/pools
def post_pool(body: PoolBody, session: SessionDep) -> PoolResponse
pool = Pool(**body.model_dump()) — direct model construction, already a supported access form (ACC-3)

already_working_at_baseline: step 5 -> 6 -> 7 (OrmAccess and Queries edges exist in the M07 pass-2 graph)
missing_at_baseline: step 3: __request(OpenAPI, {method, url}) is a configuration-object call, so no HTTP observation is made at all (M07 FE-U1)
step 4: the decorator states "" and the served path needs two levels of router prefix composition (M07 OUT-5)
steps 1-2: no call edge links a frontend module to the client function that holds the URL (M07 OUT-6)

non_regression_criteria.statement: Route-declaration precision and recall stay at 1.000 over the unchanged 101 in-scope ground-truth records.
Queries precision and recall stay at 1.000 over the unchanged 48 in-scope ground-truth records, and all 290 produced Queries edges stay source-confirmed.
The 13 must_not_produce assertions stay satisfied: no table is invented for a SQLModel class.
OrmAccess edges from non-Python files stay at 0.
Every edge keeps confidence, provenance, evidence and a source location. Zero exceptions.
No previously correct M04/M05/M06 behaviour regresses: the full workspace test suite passes, and the 19 M07 regression fixtures keep passing.

accuracy_rules.false_positive_priority: A change that adds true positives but also adds a false positive is not accepted until the false positive is investigated and either eliminated or shown to be outside the corpus. A wrong edge corrupts the architecture model; a missing edge does not.
accuracy_rules.refusal_preferred: Where evidence is insufficient — an unresolved module, an ambiguous symbol, a dynamic prefix — produce no edge and record the reason.
accuracy_rules.measurement: orm_access_unconfirmable (286 at baseline) must fall, and must not be reduced by loosening what counts as confirmable.

explicitly_out_of_scope: blast radius, structural diff, MCP, ASK
resolving Next.js rewrites or other deployment-time path rewriting
a general Python or TypeScript module resolver — only the subset the corpus exercises
